faq.title: Your pause, explained.
faq.copy: What to know before choosing RX SUBZERO and getting started at your own pace.

items.q: What is included with RX SUBZERO?
items.a: One collapsible facial basin with an integrated clear dual breathing tube and mouthpiece. The tube is permanently attached to the basin. The images show the same product open and folded.
Start with cool water, a comfortable temperature and brief intervals. Add ice gradually only if it feels appropriate for you.

items.q: How do I care for it?
items.a: Empty after use and clean the basin and its integrated tube with mild soap and water, keeping them attached. Let the whole unit air-dry fully before folding and storing.

items.q: Is cold exposure suitable for everyone?
items.a: Cold exposure may not be appropriate for everyone. If you have a health condition, sensitivity or concern, speak with a qualified healthcare professional first.

items.q: Where does it fit in my routine?
items.a: Use it as a brief cold-water step at a comfortable point in your routine. On the face, use it on clean skin, pat dry gently, and continue with the products you already use.
